title: Deleting a custom role with 0 users shows a confirmation dialog
custom_preconds: 1. A custom role named 'Copy Test Role 1' has 0 users assigned.
custom_steps:
1. On the Roles list, click the three-dot menu on 'Copy Test Role 1'.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. Look at the confirmation dialog.
  4. Read its title, message and the two buttons.
custom_expected:
A confirmation dialog opens asking you to confirm deleting the role.

On confirming, a 'Role deleted successfully.' message appears and the role is removed.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live Roles list); 'Role deleted successfully.' build-verified
evidence: 'Role deleted successfully.' confirmed in build. Exact dialog copy needs live capture.
